newsitem.title: USA: Valhi to sell Medite operations.
newsitem.headline: Valhi to sell Medite operations.

text.p: Valhi Inc said on Wednesday that it had signed letters of intent to sell its building products business operated by its Medite Corp unit for $230 million and the assumption of debt.
The company said in a statement it would sell:
- about 170,000 acres of timber and timberlands to Rogue Resources LLC, an Oregon-based partnership of forest product operators;
- the Medford, Ore.-based medium-density fibreboard plant along with a veneer and sawmill conversion facility to Sierra Pine, a California limited partnership;
- and the Irish medium density fibreboard operations to Willamette Industries Inc.
The transactions are subject to, among other things, completion of due diligence, execution of definitive agreements and certain regulatory approvals.
The total cash consideration will be about $230 million, subject to certain adjustments, plus the assumption of $20 million of foreign debt.
The transactions are expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1996, at which time the company "expects to report a pretax gain on the dispositions in excess of $100 million," the statement said.
About $53 million of the cash proceeds will be used to pay off Medite bank debt in the United States.
